name: Poultry Science Summer Immersion
org: NC State Prestage Department of Poultry Science
what_you_do: A week-long workshop where you stay overnight. You learn by doing about poultry science, animal medicine and jobs in the field. You also get info about scholarships.
who_can_apply: Rising juniors and seniors with an interest in poultry.
deadline_text: 2026 session was June 14-18, 2026. Deadline was April 3, 2026 at 5 p.m. 2027 dates not posted yet.
